patch_description: Keep the current multi-start greedy + move/swap/2-for-1 local search, but generalize the local search loop to target an arbitrary "hot" GPU. First run up to 60 iterations targeting the max-KVPR GPU; when it stalls, run a second phase targeting the second-max KVPR GPU, gated so ops must reduce the current global max. This dual-target refinement was shown effective in prior generations and should push the max KVPR lower.
